audience.text: Developers who need to generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on a server or in a build pipeline without installing PowerPoint, using COM interop, or relying on native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations, open existing ones from paths or streams, save to paths or streams, and save subsets of slides.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Add 187 types of auto shapes, configure fill (solid, gradient, pattern, picture), line properties, and visual effects like outer shadow.
capabilities.title: Add and format shapes

capabilities.text: Add text frames, paragraphs, and portions with character formatting (bold, size, font) and paragraph formatting (alignment, bullets).
capabilities.title: Format text and paragraphs

capabilities.text: Add tables with rows and columns, merge cells, configure cell borders, margins, and apply table style presets.
capabilities.title: Create and style tables

capabilities.text: Add, insert, remove, clone, and hide slides; organize slides into sections using Sections.AddSection.
capabilities.title: Manage slides and sections

capabilities.text: Create notes slides with notes text, add comment authors, and insert comments with position and timestamp on slides.
capabilities.title: Add notes and comments

capabilities.text: Load and save presentations using file paths or Stream objects, including saving to memory streams for in-memory workflows.
capabilities.title: Stream-based I/O

capabilities.text: Carry through parts the library does not model unchanged during load and save operations.
capabilities.title: Preserve unknown parts

limitations.text: Only three SaveFormat values are supported (.pptx, .ppsx, .potx); eighteen others raise NotSupportedException.
Does not support charts, animations, transitions, themes, backgrounds, group shapes, or hyperlinks.
Does not write modern threaded comments; only classic comment list format is supported.
Does not write language attributes to the XML; PowerPoint uses the authoring machine's default language.
Slide size cannot be changed; new presentations default to 4:3 screen size (9144000 × 6858000 EMU).
Picture embedding requires reading bytes into memory first; no overload accepts a file path directly.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint file generation and modification without requiring a local PowerPoint installation or COM interop.
Provides a pure .NET implementation that builds the Office Open XML package directly, avoiding native dependencies.
Supports .NET 8 and .NET 10 long-term support releases with no NuGet package dependencies.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET library that creates, reads, and edits PowerPoint .pptx presentations by building the Office Open XML package directly, with no external dependencies.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports the two ShapeType values NotDefined and Custom beyond defaulting to rectangle geometry.
Whether the library supports modern threaded comments in any capacity.
Whether document properties beyond core, extended, and custom are supported.
Whether the library supports embedded OLE objects or SmartArt.
Whether the library supports macro-enabled presentation formats.
Whether the library supports rendering to PDF, images, or HTML.
Whether the library supports transitions or animations.
Whether the library supports background formatting beyond fill types on shapes.

workflows.name: Create and save a basic presentation
workflows.text: Instantiate a Presentation object, add shapes and text to slides, and save the result as a .pptx file using SaveFormat.Pptx.

workflows.name: Format text with font properties
workflows.text: Add a text frame to a shape, set paragraph alignment, and configure font height, bold, Latin font, and solid fill color for portions.

workflows.name: Create and merge table cells
workflows.text: Add a table to a slide, populate cells with text, and merge cells horizontally using the MergeCells method.

workflows.name: Apply visual effects to shapes
workflows.text: Enable outer shadow effects on shapes by configuring blur radius and distance through the EffectFormat interface.

workflows.name: Add notes and comments
workflows.text: Create notes slides with notes text, add comment authors, and insert comments with position and timestamp.

workflows.name: Organize slides into sections
workflows.text: Add empty slides, then group them into sections using Sections.AddSection with a reference slide.
